title: Modular task-aware scoring plugins for quantized profile validation
creator: Devon Patel
description:
Goal: build a small, composable plugin system for task-aware scorers used during FP8/INT8 quantization calibration and post-quant validation. The plugin system must support multiple metric types (perplexity/text-LL, MMLU-style multi-class accuracy, Rouge/BLEU for generation, and specialized scorers for summarization/QA/reranking) and provide deterministic contracts so scoring runs are comparable across quant profiles, model variants, and CI runs.

Background: Current validation jobs are heavy monoliths that mix dataset handling, metric logic, and result aggregation. That makes it hard to add new task-specific scorers (e.g., a contrastive reranker metric, or a reference-less summary quality score) and to run small parity checks quickly during calibration. We need a standardized interface for scorer plugins, clear I/O contracts (input prediction format, reference handling, metadata like prompt/template), and integration points for sampling, bootstrapped confidence intervals, and task-weighted aggregation.

Scope:
- Define scorer plugin interface and light adapter layer for existing metric implementations (sacreBLEU, rouge, LM perplexity, custom MMLU evaluator).
- Implement baseline plugins: perplexity (batched prefix LM), MMLU-style multiple-choice accuracy, Rouge-L and BLEU for generation, and a cached reranker-contrastive scorer.
- Add reference-less summary scorer (length/coverage heuristics + embedding-based similarity fallback) as an experimental plugin.
- Provide a small runner CLI and CI step to execute a subset of scorers on a calibration shard (1000 examples) within a 2-hour wall time budget.
- Emit standardized artifacts (CSV with per-example scores, JSONL with prediction/reference/score-tags, and aggregated CSV with confidence intervals) so Console and the quality dashboard can ingest.

Non-goals: full dataset orchestration, heavy distributed eval (handled by separate infra), or model retraining. This ticket focuses on scorer contracts, core plugins, and integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: A plugin interface document (Confluence) with I/O contract and example adapters exists and is reviewed by PM and Research
Baseline scorer plugins implemented and unit-tested: perplexity, MMLU-accuracy, Rouge-L, BLEU, reranker-contrastive
CI job runs on a 1k-example calibration shard and produces per-example CSV and aggregated CSV with 95% CIs
Console ingestion docs and a sample dashboard query are provided (links included)
Experiment flag to enable reference-less summary scorer in calibration runs
Performance: scorer runner for 1k examples completes within configured infra cost budget (<=2h wall) in our calibration CI profile
technical_notes:
Design notes and trade-offs: Plugin interface will be a thin Python adapter class with three methods: load_references(metadata_path), score_batch(predictions: List[str], references: Optional[List[str]], meta: List[Dict[str,str]]) -> List[float], and aggregate(variant_label) -> dict. To keep this JSON-flat schema requirement we record notes here, but implementation will be in repo 'infra/quant-eval/score_plugins'.

- Perplexity: use tokenization and LM scoring path aligned with runtime tokenization (share tokenizer artifacts). Compute per-token cross-entropy and convert to perplexity; log prefix-length distributions.
- MMLU-style: canonicalize multiple-choice predictions to index labels; support soft labels and tie-breaking rules. Provide per-task and macro-averaged metrics.
- Rouge/BLEU: use sacrebleu and rouge implementation with stable tokenization. Add generation normalization (strip templates) adapter. Provide n-gram breakdowns in aggregated artifacts.
- Reranker-contrastive: use cached encoded embeddings (FAISS-backed dev cache) when available; fallback to on-the-fly batch embedding if cache miss. Score is pairwise margin-based metric tuned on validation set.
- Reference-less summary scorer: prototype based on SBERT cosine coverage + heuristic brevity penalty; flagged experimental.

CI integration: add GitHub Actions job 'quant-scorer-ci' that runs on changes to score_plugins/ or calibration-configs/ and writes artifacts to s3://redwood-qa/quant-validation/ci-runs/{run-id}/. Attachments: PR template requires 'datasets used' and 'compute profile' fields.

Observability: increment telemetry counters (scorer.run.*, scorer.latency_ms, scorer.error.*) and emit a sample of per-example scores to observability for error analysis.
implementation_plan:
Week 1: define interface, Confluence spec, and simple CLI runner + skeleton adapters. Week 2: implement perplexity and MMLU plugins, unit tests, and CI job. Week 3: implement Rouge/BLEU and reranker, integrate artifact upload and dashboard ingestion. Week 4: prototype reference-less scorer, run calibration heatmap, and document. Post-launch: add more task-specific scorers from Research backlog.
